1-Entrance-1	Elara	Happy	Finally made it.	Akhirnya nyampe juga
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Questioning	This place hasn't changed much, huh?	Tempat ini gak banyak berubah, ya?
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Happy	I wonder if Dad will be surprised that I suddenly showed up.	Ayah kaget gak ya, tiba-tiba aku dahh nyampe?
1-Entrance-1 Elara Happy I want to surprise Dad at the lighthouse. He should be there. Aku mau kejutin Ayah di mercusuar. Harusnya Ayah ada di sana.
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Happy	I can't wait to see Dad and walk around with him again.	Gak sabar ingin ketemu Ayah trus berkeliling.
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Normal	Come to think of it, it's been so long since I went around with Dad.	Dipikir-pikir udah lama banget gak keliling sama Ayah.
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Questioning	Three years? I think so.	3 Tahun? Sepertinya iya.
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Sad	College was really hectic, so I couldn't even stop by. Phew.	Kuliah kemaren bener-bener padet sampe gak bisa mampir. Huft.
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Happy	Yep, it's time!	Yap, ini waktunya!
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Happy	An adventure, Lara and Cahya. Hahahaa.	Pengelanaa, Lara dan Cahya. Hahahaa.
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Normal
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Shocked	Huh?	Eh?
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Questioning	Wait. Why is there someone here for once?	Bentar. Tumben ada orang di sini?
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Questioning	Dad's friend?	Temen Ayah?
1-Entrance-1	Elara	Questioning	Who could it be?	Sapa kali ya?
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Normal	Hello?	Halo?
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Nova	Normal	Hm?	Emh?
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Nova	Normal	It's unusual to see someone here. What are you doing?	Tumben ada orang ke sini. Mau ngapain?
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Questioning	(Oh, we have the same question.)	(Eh, pertanyaan kita sama)
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Normal
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Normal	Oh. I'm Mr. Cahya's daughter, Uncle. He takes care of the lighthouse over there.	Oh. Saya anak Pak Cahya, Om. Yang jaga mercusuar di sana.
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Questioning	Are you Dad's friend, Uncle?	Om temen ayah, kah?
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Nova	Normal	Cahya?	Cahya?
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Nova	Normal	Oh.	Oh.
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Questioning	Huh? What's wrong, Uncle?	Eh? Ada apa, Om?

1-Entrance-2-Nova	Nova	Normal	It's nothing. It's just rare for anyone to come to this beach. Usually there are tourists or locals around, but I don't know why it's suddenly so empty. Maybe it's haunted?	Gapapa. Jarang aja ada yang datengin pantai ini. Biasanya ada turis atau warlok ke sini, tapi ntah ngapa jadi sepi banget. Angker kali ya?

1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Angry	Haiss. Of course it isn't haunted. I've played here since I was little and nothing ever happened.	Haiss. Mana ada angker? Dari kecil aku sering main di sini ga ada apa-apa.
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Nova	Normal	You sure?	Yakin?
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Normal	Hmmmmm.	Hmmmmm.
1-Entrance-2-Nova	Elara	Normal	Ahh. Whatever. I'll go find Dad first.	Ahh. Bodoamat lah. Aku temuin Ayah dulu.
1-Entrance-3	Elara	Normal	"""Cirubai Lighthouse"""	"""Mercusuar Cirubai"""
1-Entrance-3	Elara	Normal	100m	100m
1-Entrance-4	Elara	Questioning	Huh. Uncle's already gone?	Lah. Si Om dah ilang?
1-Entrance-4	Elara	Normal	Whatever.	Yasudahlah.
1-Beach-0-1	Elara	Happy	This cool air. It's the best.	Udara sejuk ini. Emang yang terbaik.
1-Beach-0-2	Elara	Happy	Butterfliiies!	Kupu-kupuu!
1-Beach-0-2	Elara	Questioning	But why is it black?	Tapi kok hitam?
1-Beach-0-2	Elara	Happy	I'll follow it.	Ikutin dehh.
1-Beach-0-3	Elara	Shocked	EHHHHH!!!	EHHHHH!!!
1-Beach-0-3	Elara	Shocked	Why did my head suddenly get so dizzy?	Kenapa tiba-tiba kepalaku pusing banget.
1-Beach-0-3	Elara	Shocked	The lighthouse too. Why is it like that?	Mercusuarnya juga. Kenapa kek gitu?
1-Beach-0-3	Elara	Questioning	Ugh. Am I dizzy from riding the bus earlier?	Aduh. Apa aku mabuk perkara naik bis tadi?
1-Beach-0-3	Elara	Normal	I have to get through.	Aku harus lewat.
1-Beach-0-4	Elara	Shocked	WHAT HAPPENED???!	APA YANG TERJADI???!
1-Beach-0-4	Elara	Shocked	Where am I???	Di manaa aku???
1-Beach-0-4	Elara	Shocked	What's wrong with my eyes? Why did everything suddenly go dark?	Mataku kenapa? Kok tiba-tiba semuanya jadi gelap?
1-Beach-0-4	Elara	Normal	I have to stay conscious.	Aku harus sadar.
1-Beach-0-5	Elara	Shocked	These butterflies!!!	Kupu-kupu ini!!!
1-Beach-0-5	Elara	Questioning	Are they here to guide me?	Apa mereka di sini untuk menuntunku?
1-Beach-0-5 Elara Normal I have to follow them. Aku harus mengikuti mereka.
1-Beach-0-6	Elara	Questioning	Everything's slowly returning to normal? Is it because of those butterflies earlier?	Semuanya perlahan kembali normal? Gara-gara kupu-kupu tadi, ya?
1-Beach-0-6	Elara	Questioning	It seems like they're not ordinary butterflies?	Sepertinya mereka bukan kupu-kupu biasa?
1-Beach-0-7	Elara	Happy	I'm back. Good thing those strange butterflies were there.	Akhirnya aku kembali. Untung tadi ada kupu-kupu aneh itu.
1-Beach-0-7	Elara	Sad	Phew. What actually happened?	Huft. Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.
1-Beach-0-7	Elara	Normal
1-Beach-0-7	Elara	Sad	I must be exhausted.	Sepertinya aku kelelahan.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Questioning	Huh. That uncle again.	Lah. Si Om lagi.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Questioning	Why are you here?	Kok ke sini?
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Nova	Normal	It's nothing. Just ignore me.	Gapapa. Abaikan saja aku.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Nova	Normal	Why were you lying there earlier?	Tadi kamu kenapa tiduran di sana?
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Questioning	(So this Uncle has been watching me all this time??)	(Jadi selama ini Si Om ngeliatin aku??)
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Sad	(Hmmmmmm. This uncle is kinda creepy.)	(Hmmmmmm. Rada serem om-om satu ini.)
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Normal
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Angry	You already knew someone had fainted. And you just left her there.	Udah tau ada orang pingsan. Malah didiemin.

1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Nova	Normal	You were surrounded by butterflies earlier. I was afraid that if I helped you, they'd fly away.	Tadi kamu dikerumunin kupu-kupu soalnya. Takutnya kalo kubantu, kupu-kupunya malah lari.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Angry	(What kind of excuse is that??)	(Alasan apa pula itu??)
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Angry	That doesn't help!	Gak ngebantu!
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Nova	Normal	I told you, this place is haunted.	Kan udah kubilang, tempat ini angker.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Nova	Normal	Even the butterflies are weird. They're pitch black.	Kupu-kupunya pun aneh tuh. Item pekat gitu.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Normal	At least the butterflies helped me earlier.	Setidaknya kupu-kupunya ngebantu aku tadi.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Nova	Normal	Helped you?	Ngebantu?
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Normal	Yeah, I followed them. Then I woke up.	Iya, tadi aku ngikutin mereka. Setelah itu aku kebangun.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Nova	Normal	Hmmm. Good, then.	Hmmm. Bagus kalo gitu.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova Nova Normal Just follow them then. It seems like those butterflies are guiding your way. Ikutin aja brarti. Sepertinya Kupu-kupu itu memandu jalanmu.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Normal	Hemm. Yeah, I know.	Hemm. Iya tau.
1-Beach-0-8-Nova	Elara	Happy	Alright. I'm going to find Dad.	Yaudah. Aku mo nemuin Ayah.
1-Beach-0-9	Elara	Happy	This is the moment.	Ini saatnya.
1-Beach-0-9	Elara	-	*locked*	*terkunci
1-Beach-0-9	Elara	Questioning	Huhh. Why is it locked? Dad isn't inside?	Lahh. Kok kekunci? Ayah gak di dalem?
1-Beach-0-9	Elara	Questioning	Your dad isn't here?	Ayahmu gak ada?
1-Beach-0-9	Elara	Normal	Yeah. He's usually inside.	Iya, loh. Biasanya dia di dalam.
1-Beach-0-9	Elara	Questioning	Maybe he went out?	Lagi keluar mungkin?
1-Beach-0-9 Elara Normal Yeah, maybe. I'll check the left side of the beach first. Iya kali ya? Aku coba cek di sisi kiri pantai dulu deh.
1-Beach-0-9	Elara	Normal	We used to play there a lot.	Dulu kami sering main di sana.
1-Beach-0-10	Elara	-	*locked*	*terkunci
1-Beach-0-10	Elara	Normal	Dad must be somewhere around the beach.	Sepertinya ayah ada di sekitar pantai.
1-Beach-0-11	Elara	Questioning	Uncle's gone again?	Si Om dah ilang?
1-Beach-0-11	Elara	Angry	Whatever, that guy is seriously creepy.	Yaudahlah, tu orang nyeremin asli.
1-Beach-0-12	Elara	Shocked	Huh. The door's open?	Lah. Kebuka pintunya?
1-Beach-0-12	Elara	Questioning	Is Dad inside?	Ayah di dalam, kah?
1-Beach-0-12	Elara	Normal	Okay, I'll just go in then.	Oke, aku masuk aja kalo gitu.
1-Beach-0-13	Elara	Normal	Why would I go outside? Dad seems to be inside.	Ngapain aku keluar. Ayah sepertinya di dalam.
1-Beach-1-1	Elara	Happy	Ahh, the melody of the waves.	Ahh, senandung ombak.
1-Beach-1-1	Elara	Happy	Its dance, its breeze.	Tariannya, hembusannya.
1-Beach-1-1	Elara	Happy	There's nothing quite like it.	Gak ada duanya pokokk.
1-Beach-1-2	Elara	Sad	By the way, I don't see Dad here either.	Omong-omong aku gak ngeliat Ayah juga di sini.
1-Beach-1-2	Elara	Questioning	Maybe I'll just wait for Dad?	Aku tungguin Ayah aja kali, ya?
1-Beach-1-2	Elara	Happy	My favorite place back then.	Tempat favoritku dulu.
1-Beach-1-3	Elara	Shocked	OH MY GOD! This pressure again!	ASTAGA! Tekanan ini lagi!
1-Beach-1-3	Elara	Shocked	What now???	Sekarang apa lagi???
1-Beach-1-3	Elara	Shocked	A swing? First the lighthouse, now a swing??	Ayunan? Tadi mercusuar sekarang ayunan??
1-Beach-1-4	Elara	Shocked	ASGJASOIGJAOSIGJ	ASGJASOIGJAOSIGJ
1-Beach-1-4	Elara	Angry	THIS PLACE IS SO WEIRD.	GAKK ANEHH KOK TEMPAT INI.
1-Beach-1-4	Elara	Normal	Calm down, Lara. You must be tired.	Tenang, Lara. Sepertinya kamu lelah.
1-Beach-1-4	Elara	Normal	As long as it hasn't happened three times, it probably means your head is just dizzy.	Selagi belum 3 kali, brarti emang kepalamu yang lagi pusing.
1-Beach-1-4 Elara Normal Remember what happened earlier. I have to follow the butterflies. Inget cara tadi. Aku harus ikutin kupu-kupu.
1-Beach-1-5	Elara	Questioning	Why is the rope broken? Why?	Kok talinya putus? Kenapa gitu?
1-Beach-1-5	Elara	Normal	Forget it, this is just my hallucination.	Lupakan, ini hanya halusinasiku.
1-Beach-1-5	Elara	Normal	I have to get out first.	Aku harus keluar terlebih dahulu.
1-Beach-1-5	Elara	Normal	Follow those butterflies again.	Ikutin kupu-kupu itu lagi.
1-Beach-1-6	Elara	Happy	There. I'm out again.	Nahh. Aku keluar lagi.
1-Beach-1-6	Elara	Happy	So the butterfly theory was right.	Berarti teori kupu-kupu itu benar.
1-Beach-1-6	Elara	Questioning	Wait.	Tunggu.
1-Beach-1-6	Elara	Questioning	But why is the swing's rope broken now?	Tapi kenapa sekarang tali ayunannya putus?
1-Beach-1-6	Elara	Questioning	Didn't it feel like this when I arrived earlier?	Perasaann tadi waktu nyampe gak gini?
1-Beach-1-6 Elara Normal I have to fix the swing. Aku harus perbaiki ayunannya
1-Beach-1-7-Minigames	Elara	Normal	The swing's rope shouldn't be broken.	Harusnya tali ayunannya ini tidak putus.
1-Beach-1-7-Minigames	Elara	Normal	I have to fix it.	Aku harus perbaikinya.
1-Beach-1-8-Minigames	Elara	Happy	There. That's better.	Nah. Ini baru benar.
1-Beach-1-8-Minigames	Elara	Happy	My favorite swing.	Ayunan favoritku.
1-Beach-1-8-Minigames	Elara	Normal
1-Beach-1-8-Minigames	Elara	Normal	Hmmmm.	Hmmmm.
1-Beach-1-8-Minigames	Elara	Sad	Why am I getting scared being here for so long?	Kok aku jadi takut ya lama-lama di sini.
1-Beach-1-8-Minigames	Elara	Sad	I'll go look for Dad again. Where is heee?	Aku cari Ayah lagi aja deh. Mana sih Ayahh.

1-Interior-1	Elara	Happy	AWESO�	ASIKNY--

1-Interior-2	Elara	Normal	Dad's book collection.	Koleksi buku-buku Ayah.
1-Interior-2	Elara	Normal	Ugh. They're so old-fashioned. Some are even older than me.	Duh. Jadul-jadul banget. Bahkan banyak yang lebih tua dariku.
1-Interior-3	Elara	Normal	There's an empty glass on the table.	Ada gelas kosong nih di meja.
1-Interior-3	Elara	Questioning	Looks like Dad was drinking. Then he just left it and went somewhere.	Sepertinya ayah habis minum. Trus ditinggal entah ke mana.
1-Interior-4	Elara	Happy	Once I find Dad, I want to cook some noodles.	Pokok setelah ketemu Ayah, aku mau masak Mie.
1-Interior-4	Elara	Happy	Instant noodles with a view sounds nice. I'll eat them on the swing later.	Mie Instan with the view kan asik. Ntar makan di ayunan.
1-Interior-5	Elara	Normal	Here it is. The door to the top of the lighthouse.	Ini dia. Pintu ke mercusuar atas.
1-Interior-5	Elara	Normal	Dad usually keeps watch up there while reading a book.	Biasanya ayah berjaga di atas sambil baca buku.
1-Interior-5	Elara	Happy	I'll surprise him!	Kagetin ah!
1-Interior-6	Elara	-	*locked*	*terkunci
1-Interior-6	Elara	Angry	Like this every timeeee!	Gini aja terussss!
1-Interior-6	Elara	Questioning	Where could Dad be? Maybe in the next room??	Ni Ayah ke mana coba. Di ruang sebelah kah??

1-Interior-8	Elara	Happy	Yep. Of course.	Yap. Tentu.

1-Interior-8 Elara Normal I'll check the desk first. Maybe Dad left a note or something. Aku coba cek di meja dulu kali, barangkali ayah ninggalin pesan ato apa gitu.

1-Interior-9-Minigames	Elara	Questioning	Is this a photo of me?	Sepertinya fotoku?
1-Interior-9-Minigames	Elara	Angry	This is a serious offense, Dad.	Pelanggaran berat Ayah ini.
1-Interior-9-Minigames	Elara	Normal	I'll fix it first.	Aku perbaiki dulu, deh.
1-Interior-10-Minigames	Elara	Happy	There. All done.	Nah selesai.
1-Interior-10-Minigames	Elara	Questioning	When did I take this photo?	Kapan aku ambil foto ini.
1-Interior-10-Minigames	Elara	Questioning	Wait, there's a date on it.	Bentar, ada tanggalnya.
1-Interior-10-Minigames	Elara	Shocked	July 16, 199-	16 Juli 199-
1-Interior-10-Minigames	Elara	Shocked	HUH?! Isn't July 16 just yesterday? I feel like I only arrived this afternoon.	LAHH! 16 Juli bukannya kemaren? Perasaan aku baru nyampe siang ini.
1-Interior-10-Minigames	Elara	Shocked	How could I have already taken this photo?	Kok bisa aku udah ambil foto duluan?
1-Interior-10-Minigames	Elara	Sad	Enoughhhh. Things are getting more and more confusing here.	Udahhhh. Semakin gak jelas di sini.
1-Interior-10-Minigames	Elara	Normal	I have to find Dad. If he's not inside, then he must be outside.	Aku harus nyari ayah. Kalo di dalem gak ada, brarti ada di luar.
1-Interior-11	Elara	Shocked	HAAAAHHHH???!!!	HAHHHH???!!!
1-Interior-11	Elara	Shocked	Why did it suddenly become such a mess???	Kokk tiba-tiba berantakan gini???
1-Interior-11	Elara	Sad	It's not just messy anymore. It looks like it hasn't been maintained.	Ini gak lagi berantakan, tapi kek dah gak terawat.
1-Interior-11	Elara	Shocked	Ugh. I need to get out.	Aduhh. Aku musti keluar.
1-Interior-12	Elara	Shocked	THAT'S THREE TIMES ALREADYYY. PLUS WHAT HAPPENED INSIDE.	UDAH 3 KALIII. KETAMBAHAN YANG DI DALEM TADI.
1-Interior-12	Elara	Angry	FOR SURE. Something is wrong with this place.	FIX. Ada yang gak beres sama tempat ini.
1-Interior-12	Elara	Sad	That uncle was right, this place really is haunted.	Bener kataa om tadi, ni tempat angker.
1-Interior-12	Elara	Shocked	I have to get out of this place immediately.	Aku harus segera keluar dari tempat ini.
1-Interior-12	Elara	Happy	Oh, right. The butterflies!	Ohya benar. Kupu-kupu!
1-Interior-12 Elara Normal I have to find the butterflies! Aku harus cari kupu-kupu!
1-Interior-13	Elara	Shocked	WHHHHAAAAT???!!! WHAT THE HECK IS THAT???	WAHHHHH???!!! APA PULAK ITU???
1-Interior-14	Elara	Shocked	ASOIGFJAOSIDGJOID	ASOIGFJAOSIDGJOID
1-Interior-14	Elara	Shocked	Did I just die??	Aku barusan mati??

1-Interior-14	Elara	Shocked	Whatever happens, I can't touch that fog. I have to run away immediately.	Yang pasti aku gak boleh nyentuh kabut itu. Aku harus segera lari.
1-Interior-15	Elara	Happy	Ahhh. I did it.	Ahhh. Berhasil.
1-Interior-15	Elara	Sad	This is seriously scary. I don't want to get trapped here for too long.	Serem banget asli. Gamau kejebak di sini lama-lama.
1-Interior-15	Elara	Happy	Butterfliiies. Where are youuu!	Kupuu-kupu. Mana kamuuu!
1-Interior-16	Elara	Questioning	Wait, I didn't imagine that, right?	Eh, tadi aku gak salah lihat, kan?
1-Interior-16	Elara	Questioning	Was there a shadow that looked like me? Or was that me?	Ada bayangan mirip aku? Ato itu aku?
1-Interior-16	Elara	Shocked	This place is getting more and more wrong. I have to get out immediately.	Semakin gak bener tempat ini. Aku harus segera keluar.
1-Interior-16	Elara	Questioning	Where's the exit?	Mana pintu keluarnya?
1-Interior-17	Elara	Happy	I'm back again.	Akhirnya aku kembali.
1-Interior-17	Elara	Normal	I have to find another way out.	Aku harus cari jalan lain buat keluar.
1-Interior-18	Elara	Sad	Oh my godddd. So I can't go through here.	Astagaaa. Berarti aku gabisa lewat sini.
1-Interior-18	Elara	Questioning	Is there another way on the second floor?	Adakah jalan lain di lantai 2?

1-Interior-19	Elara	Questioning	What actually happened here?	Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi di sini?
1-Interior-19	Elara	Shocked	I have to get out and find Dad.	Aku harus segera keluar dan cari ayah.
